g.text: (or Reject / Take down with a reason,
[status is not the one the action needs]
"This listing is no longer waiting for approval."
[approve, or an edit that moves a Published listing (spec 005, REQ-005-6)]
lock the region's row; give the listing
(+ published_at and slug / reason / edited fields)
The decision is saved and committed
[the Admin owns the listing, or an edit changed nothing]
and the listing id, nothing else
No second attempt. The owner still sees the outcome in My listings.
The approval email carries two links: the listing's public page first,
then the listing in My listings (spec 005, REQ-005-10). The others carry the second only.
After approve and reject the Admin is back on the queue; after take down and edit, on the listing.
